character.prompt:
Create a 16-bit pixel-art sprite sheet for a character in a retro running/RPG game called Runners Quest.

The character is a 40-something recreational runner and weekend-warrior dad, designed with affectionate humor and the visual style of an early-1990s arcade or 16-bit sports game.

He is not a superhero, action figure, elite athlete, or fantasy warrior. He looks like an ordinary guy who goes running on Saturday mornings.

The humor comes from the contrast: this completely normal recreational runner is being treated by the game as the hero of an epic RPG quest. Running is what makes him heroic—not looking like a conventional hero.

Character design

Create one consistent male character with:

approximately 40–49 years old
slight dad bod: active and reasonably fit, but with some softness around the middle
normal human proportions with mild 16-bit arcade exaggeration for readability
strong recreational-runner legs without an exaggerated muscular physique
prominent retro mustache
ordinary short dad hair, slightly receding
retro wraparound sports sunglasses
gold/yellow athletic headband
early-1990s running singlet, primarily blue
era-appropriate short running shorts
white crew athletic socks
chunky retro running shoes with subtle blue/gold accents

His blue and gold elements should harmonize with a blue-and-gold early-1990s arcade game logo, but the character should remain visually distinct from the logo.

Avoid excessive neon colors or a palette that would compete with a blue-and-gold title logo.
